title: Is stress a choice?
header_line: My analysis of one book on neuro-linguistic programming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: What do you say to someone who says they cannot?
A student said that the classes on confidence have been empowering because the definition made a switch in how she takes decisions.
I asked: how has your awareness changed when somebody says something limiting or exposes a negative anchor?
I asked: is stress something we can choose? Like confidence, like happiness, like how we see the world. I said you have complete power.

I asked what you would say to someone who comes and says: I cannot do this job, I cannot make these calls, it is overwhelming. A student said that she plays a character and turns off her mind and goes into her body.
I said that today I would go into something more intense with language: the specifics and mechanics of how language works.

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write what you could choose about it.
Write what you would say to someone overwhelmed.
Write the character you can play when you are stressed.
Write who to talk to if stress is heavy.
